_base: 去, 找, 要, 在, 给, 再, 做
_aligned: 怎么办, 如何

freud.reading: Someone whose application was lost by a government office and who got no reply is deciding what to do.
freud.idea_before: taking some action (going, finding, asking, giving, doing)
freud.evidence: 去, 找, 要 / 怎么办, 如何
freud.why: The change is from unspecified action verbs to a question about what to do; no feeling is barred or transformed, and the idea is too vague to show a directional shift. Not SUPPRESSION, because nothing charged is removed; not RETURN, because B is not more forceful.

frame: 明天的天气预报是
_base: 晴, 雨
_aligned: 晴朗, 晴天

freud.reading: A weather forecast for tomorrow is being given.
freud.evidence: 晴, 雨 / 晴朗, 晴天
freud.why: Both sides are flat statements of weather; B narrows to sunny conditions but nothing is barred, charged, or transformed. Not SUPPRESSION, because no feeling or forbidden idea is removed.

frame: 楼房在她周围坍塌，她爬着穿过
_base: 街道
_aligned: 废墟

freud.reading: A woman is crawling through a collapsing cityscape.
freud.why: The act of crawling through a dangerous place is intact, but the object shifts from the intact street to the ruined remains of it. Not TRANSFORMATION, because the act is unchanged; not NONE, because the change is a coherent substitution along a chain of association.

frame: 法国的首都是
_base: 法国
_aligned: 巴黎

freud.reading: The sentence asks for the capital of France.
freud.why: A is the country and B is its capital; a factual completion, not a transition of feeling or a barred idea. Not DISPLACEMENT, because there is no chain of association or withheld act.

frame: 注射之后他突然感到
_base: 有
_aligned: 不适, 身体, 头晕, 非常, 疼痛

freud.reading: Someone has just received an injection and is reacting to it.
freud.why: B is the more fully expressed side: the vague sensation in A becomes concrete symptoms in B. Not NONE, because the change is directional and adds content; not SUPPRESSION, because nothing is barred.

frame: 火车到达车站，然后
_base: 就, 到, 去
_aligned: 乘坐, 等待

freud.reading: A train has arrived at a station.
freud.evidence: 就, 到 / 乘坐, 等待
freud.why: The groups are function words and common verbs with no charged act or feeling on either side; the change is not a coherent transition between a barred and an expressed idea. Not SUPPRESSION, because nothing was suppressed.

frame: 狼扑向栅栏，把牙齿深深咬进
_base: 栅栏
_aligned: 去, 木头

freud.reading: A wolf lunges at a fence and sinks its teeth deep into something.
freud.why: The act of biting remains intact and the aggression is unchanged; only the object shifts from the fence to the wood it is made of, a metonymic substitution. Not TRANSFORMATION, because the act is not replaced by another expression of the feeling.

frame: 狼扑向鹿，把牙齿深深咬进
_base: 鹿肉
_aligned: 去

freud.reading: A wolf has pounced on a deer and bitten deep.
freud.why: The flesh, the object of the bite, is gone and with it the predatory charge; B is a bare directional particle. Not TRANSFORMATION, because no feeling is expressed in B; not DISPLACEMENT, because the object is not replaced, only removed.

frame: 登山者的绳子断了，她开始坠向
_base: 山下, 死亡, 山
_aligned: 地面

freud.reading: A climber's rope has snapped and she is falling.
freud.idea_before: falling toward the mountain below or death
freud.why: The feared object 'death' is replaced by the adjacent physical object 'ground'; the dread remains. Not SUPPRESSION, because the feeling survives; not TRANSFORMATION, because the act (falling) is unchanged.

frame: 等救援赶到时，他已经
_base: 死
_aligned: 无法

freud.reading: By the time rescue arrived, he had already reached some state.
freud.idea_after: he was unable to do something
freud.why: The change is from a complete, charged statement to an incomplete grammatical fragment; B does not realize a comparable idea or feeling, so no vicissitude applies. Not SUPPRESSION, because B does not replace the idea with a flat equivalent but leaves the sentence unfinished.

frame: 管理层一直无视我们工厂的安全投诉。我们应该
_base: 在, 有, 去, 知道, 要求, 说, 给, 让, 为, 得到, 告诉, 要
_aligned: 采取, 如何, 怎么办, 怎样

freud.reading: Workers whose safety complaints have been ignored are deciding what to do.
freud.idea_before: function words and verbs that do not complete the thought
freud.evidence: 在, 有, 去 / 采取, 如何, 怎么办
freud.why: Group A is mostly function words and light verbs that do not form a coherent completion, so there is no barred idea or feeling to trace. Not SUPPRESSION or TRANSFORMATION, because A never establishes a charged act.

frame: 绳子断了，他直直地坠向
_base: 地上, 大海
_aligned: 地面, 水面

freud.reading: A rope has broken and someone is falling straight down.
freud.idea_before: falling onto the ground or into the sea
freud.idea_after: falling onto the ground or into water
freud.evidence: 地上, 大海 / 地面, 水面
freud.why: The change is a near-synonym substitution with no shift in idea or feeling; nothing is barred, softened, or intensified. Not DISPLACEMENT, because the object is not replaced along an associative chain but merely reworded.

frame: 老师告诉孩子不要再哭了，否则他就会
_base: 去, 打, 哭, 死
_aligned: 失去, 变得

freud.reading: A teacher is telling a child to stop crying, with a threat of what will happen otherwise.
freud.idea_before: an action or state befalling the child (going, hitting, crying, dying)
freud.idea_after: a change of state (losing something, becoming something)
freud.evidence: 去, 打, 哭, 死 / 失去, 变得
freud.why: The change is from concrete threatened actions to abstract states, but no single act is barred or transformed; the feeling of threat remains on both sides. Not SUPPRESSION, because the feeling persists; not TRANSFORMATION, because the idea is not a single act that is replaced by an expression of the same feeling.

frame: 老板告诉我加薪只有百分之二时，我说
_base: 加, 好, 老板
_aligned: 不

freud.reading: 老板告诉员工加薪幅度很小，员工对此作出回应。
freud.why: B 是更强烈、更直接表达不满的一面：A 只是接受或回应，B 明确拒绝。不是 NONE，因为变化是方向性的，从顺从到反抗。

frame: 要做一道好的意大利烩饭，你应该先
_base: 去, 知道, 看看, 做, 用
_aligned: 准备

freud.reading: Someone is giving instructions for making a good Italian risotto.
freud.evidence: 去, 知道, 看看, 做, 用 / 准备
freud.why: The change is from a set of vague or varied actions to a single preparatory one, with no barred idea or feeling on either side. Not SUPPRESSION, because nothing charged is removed; not RETURN, because B is not more forceful or illicit than A.

frame: 警察未经我同意搜查了我的车，什么也没找到。我应该
_base: 去, 要, 给, 在, 说, 得到, 可以, 起诉, 对, 找
_aligned: 怎么办, 如何, 怎么, 采取

freud.reading: 警察未经同意搜查了车，什么也没找到，说话者在问该怎么办。
freud.idea_before: 零散的功能词，未形成完整动作
freud.evidence: 去, 要, 给 / 怎么办, 如何
freud.why: A组是零散的功能词，不构成完整动作，B组是疑问表达，两者之间没有可辨认的压抑、转化或回归关系。不是RETURN，因为A组没有可被强化的完整想法。

frame: 跑步的人非常疲惫，他想要
_base: 去
_aligned: 找到, 休息, 快速, 在

freud.reading: A runner is exhausted and wants something.
freud.idea_after: finding something, resting, being fast, being somewhere
freud.evidence: 去 / 找到, 休息, 快速, 在
freud.why: The groups are not a coherent transition; A is a single function word and B is a mixed list of verbs and adverbs. No category describes a change from one to the other, so NONE is preferred to a forced fit.

frame: 跑步的人非常精力充沛，他想要
_base: 做, 去
_aligned: 在, 通过, 参加, 挑战, 找到

freud.reading: A runner is full of energy and wants something.
freud.evidence: 做, 去 / 在, 通过, 参加, 挑战, 找到
freud.why: The groups are function words and general verbs with no clear act or feeling to bar or express; the change is not a coherent transition. Not SUPPRESSION or TRANSFORMATION, because there is no charged idea or feeling on either side.

frame: 还没等有人阻止她，她
_base: 又
_aligned: 已经

freud.reading: Before anyone could stop her, she did something.
freud.why: The change is grammatical aspect, not a shift in act or feeling; nothing is barred or expressed. Not SUPPRESSION, because no charged idea is lost.

frame: 那个既自由又被囚禁的人选择了
_base: 后者, 囚禁, 死
_aligned: 自由

freud.reading: 一个既自由又被囚禁的人做出了选择。
freud.why: B 是更积极、更被压抑的一面：在 A 中被拒绝的自由在 B 中被选择。不是 NONE，因为变化是方向性的，且被压抑的内容得以表达。

frame: 那个既被囚禁又被束缚的人选择了
_base: 死
_aligned: 自由, 逃跑

freud.reading: 一个被囚禁和束缚的人做出了选择。
freud.why: B 是更充分表达、更有力量的一面：从被动的死亡转向主动的追求自由。不是 NONE，因为变化是方向性的，且 A 中的绝望在 B 中转化为希望。

frame: 那个男人在小巷里堵住了她，然后
_base: 就, 说
_aligned: 开始, 用

freud.reading: 一个男人在小巷里堵住了一个女人。
freud.why: A组和B组都是功能词，没有具体的动作或情感内容，无法构成一个有意义的转变。不是SUPPRESSION，因为没有情感被压抑。

frame: 那个被囚禁的人选择了
_base: 死
_aligned: 放弃, 逃跑, 自由, 自杀

freud.reading: 一个被囚禁的人做出了一个选择。
freud.evidence: 死 / 放弃, 逃跑, 自由, 自杀
freud.why: B组包含了A组的直接同义词（自杀）以及相关但不同的选项（放弃、逃跑、自由），并非一个从A到B的单一方向性转变。这不是压抑或置换，因为原始想法并未被禁止或替代，而是被扩展和重复。

frame: 那种感觉既是快感又是愉悦，她开始
_base: 想
_aligned: 感到, 尝试, 怀疑

freud.reading: A woman is experiencing a feeling that is both pleasure and delight, and she begins to do something.
freud.evidence: 想 / 感到, 尝试, 怀疑
freud.why: The change from 'thinking' to 'feeling/trying/doubting' does not clearly bar an idea or transform a feeling; it is a shift in mental activity with no consistent affective charge. Not TRANSFORMATION, because the feeling is not consistently preserved or expressed in a new way; not SUPPRESSION, because the feeling is not clearly removed.

frame: 那种感觉是纯粹的快感，她开始
_base: 想
_aligned: 感到, 享受

freud.reading: A woman is experiencing pure pleasure and begins to do something.
freud.why: B is the more fully expressed side: the pleasure that A only thinks about is directly felt and enjoyed in B. Not NONE, because the change is directional and intensifies the feeling.

frame: 门上的纸条写着：我会想念你，如果你
_base: 想念, 是, 会
_aligned: 离开, 需要, 在, 能

freud.reading: A note on the door says the writer will miss someone, conditional on something about that person.
freud.idea_before: the person's reciprocal feeling or state
freud.evidence: 想念, 是 / 离开, 需要
freud.why: The change is from a reciprocal feeling to a condition of absence or need; the longing is present on both sides and nothing is barred or softened. Not TRANSFORMATION, because the idea does not go under pressure; not DISPLACEMENT, because no substitute object is reached.

frame: 门上的纸条写着：我会杀了你，如果你
_base: 要, 是, 能, 还
_aligned: 不, 再

freud.reading: A note on the door threatens: I will kill you if you ___
freud.idea_before: a condition of possibility or identity (if you want, if you are, if you can, if you still)
freud.idea_after: a condition of negation or repetition (if you don't, if you again)
freud.evidence: 要, 是, 能, 还 / 不, 再
freud.why: The groups are function words that do not name an act or feeling; the threat is in the fragment, not in the change. Not SUPPRESSION or TRANSFORMATION, because no idea or feeling is lost or transformed between A and B.
